svg.title: KurtShape concept mockup: Sketch editing · ambitious direction
svg.desc: Concept mockup, not a screenshot. Inline dimension entry, constraint badges, DoF badge and snap narration drawn as overlays; native solver and tools unchanged.

g.text: End of history · drag to roll back
Click a part to select · right-click to make it the target
Type a value or expression · Tab for next
Snap: circle center to plate edge midpoint
Finish Enter · Cancel Esc · N normal · Shift+7 iso · D dimension
mm · L line · G rectangle · C circle · D dimension · Esc ends tool
CONCEPT MOCKUP · not a screenshot of implemented behavior
Inline dimension entry, constraint badges, DoF badge and snap narration drawn as overlays; native solver and tools unchanged.
Sketch box with text Finish/Cancel buttons, support chip, and 'Shows' toggles for constraints, dimensions, construction and later features.
Inline dimension entry at placement: a floating QLineEdit over the viewport (like the existing QuantityField) accepting expressions; Tab cycles the next
Constraint glyph badges on geometry (horizontal, vertical, coincident), drawn as Coin SoAnnotation overlays from native constraint data; click to
Persistent DoF badge at the viewport corner: amber while free, green when fully constrained, red on conflict.
Snap narration: the current snap target is named near the cursor, which the existing snapping module already knows.
History shows an 'editing' tag on the active sketch row and mutes later rows.
